name: Asimov Ventures
identity_check: Confirmed as Asimov Ventures (asimovventures.com), the New York early-stage VC that Alan Meckler, John Meckler and Tyler Benster launched in 2015 as a 3D-printing and robotics fund. Its homepage says it invests in 3D printing, robotics and computing, and its LinkedIn company page links back to asimovventures.com. The portfolio page lists additive-manufacturing, robotics and AI-chip companies (Phase3D, Fortius Metals, Burro, Ghost Robotics, Fabric8Labs, Positron), which matches the deep tech / hardware seed lead. It is not Asimov (asimov.com), the synthetic-biology company, and not the similarly named Asimov Venture Capital or Asimov Capital Partners that show up in directory searches. It is also not 'Asimov', the name of Positron AI's inference chip, although Positron is an Asimov Ventures portfolio company. Many of the firm's announcements appeared on 3DPrint.com, which is run by 3DR Holdings, where John Meckler works (team page). Coverage there is affiliated.

Portfolio centers on additive-manufacturing equipment and materials, medical 3D printing, robots and AI chips; it also awards small uncapped SAFEs to startup-competition winners.

open_items: Fund sizes unknown. Fund I targeted $30M in Aug 2015 ('We are raising $30 million.' / planned close end of October) and closed to new investors in Nov 2016, final size not published. Fund II launched Nov 2016 with no size or close found. No later fund found. SEC EDGAR refused the declared User-Agent, so Form D filings (for example, Asimov Ventures I LP) were not checked.
Check size not stated by the firm or in any press found. Directory figures ($100K–$1M) were only seen in search snippets and are not recorded.

No dedicated pitch or application form. The contact page is a general form (name, phone, email, subject, message), and the firm does not say whether it takes cold pitches, so accepts_cold_inbound = unknown.

Stages: the firm only says 'early-stage'. pre_seed/seed comes from its deals ($15K competition SAFEs, seed rounds) and database stage mixes (Tracxn: Seed and Grant entries; aVenture: mostly Seed, 1 Pre-Seed).
leads = true rests on the Dec 2015 Wiivv seed, which Asimov co-led. In every recent round found (Phase3D 2026, Positron 2025), Asimov is a participant, not a lead.

Only 2 of the 8 rounds fall in the last 24 months. The Positron Feb 2025 seed rests on CB Insights plus the firm's portfolio page: press on that round (TelecomTalk/Reuters) and Positron's Sept 2026 $875M Series C release do not name Asimov Ventures.

Two of the 8 rounds are $15,000 startup-competition prize investments (OsseoPrint 3D 2019, Particle3D 2020). Particle3D's rename to Ossiform is inferred from Tracxn and the matching 'we print bone' tagline, not confirmed on a fetched page.

Portfolio companies with recent rounds where the fetched announcement does not name Asimov: Fortius Metals (Oct 2024 $2M Seed+, Pulse 2.0), Z-Polymers (Mar 2026 Series Seed with Kureha), Nanochon (Seed Prime II, Jan 2026), Metamason (Jun 2016 $3M seed release), Burro/Augean Robotics (Apr 2019 $1.5M seed, Ben Franklin coverage; a UPenn GRASP page lists Asimov among Burro's backers but describes no round).

No round page naming Asimov found for Fabric8Labs (acquired by TDK per the portfolio page; databases disagree on Asimov's round), Ghost Robotics, Kiwibot/Robot.com, Quantum Elements, Tacit, Novineer, OptiLung, Viabot, Nanoforge, Arka or Twikit.
Wiivv seed currency is not stated (BetaKit uses '$' only). Wiivv = FitMyFoot is inferred from fitmyfoot.com running on the 'wiivv-wearables' Shopify store, and from the firm listing fitmyfoot.com.
Titles for Tyler Benster and John Meckler ('Partner') come from Tracxn. The firm's team page gives no titles. Alan Meckler's title comes from BetaKit and 3DPrint.com.

Indian founders: not stated anywhere. requires_us_entity: unknown. The 2015 launch said the focus is US with overseas deals considered, and the portfolio includes Canadian (Wiivv) and Scandinavian (Particle3D) companies.
3DPrint.com, the source for the fund announcements and three of the rounds, is run by 3DR Holdings, where partner John Meckler works (team page). Treat it as affiliated coverage.
